'''Volgax''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Volgax system/Legends|Volgax system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
Ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of an [[Extinct Volgax society|extinct civilization]], the Ruins of Volgax ancient cities were restored and used by [[the Crucible]] as a [[Dueling Pits|training base]] for slaves fighters during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. After the visit of [[Zayne Carrick]], the training facility was evacuated in [[3963 BBY]].
